settings.heading: Terms & Conditions
settings.introduction:
Welcome to Fineyst. By accessing our website or placing an order with us, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

Please read these terms carefully before submitting your order.
settings.contact_description: If you have questions or need clarification regarding our Terms & Conditions, please contact our team:
settings.cta_text: Our customer service team is ready to assist you with any questions about our terms and conditions.

settings.heading: 1. Direct Checkout Orders & Artwork Approval
settings.body:
Customers are responsible for reviewing all artwork, text, colors, sizes, quantities, uploaded files, and other order specifications before checkout. Where our product page explicitly states that an order is print-ready or does not require separate proof approval, submitting the order authorizes us to begin production using the supplied files.

If a proof is offered or required for a particular product, follow the approval instructions communicated with that proof. Contact us immediately if you notice a significant problem. Once production begins, changes or cancellations may not be possible.

settings.heading: 2. Order Acceptance & Process
settings.body:
All orders are subject to review and acceptance. We may contact you about unusable artwork, missing information, production limitations, or order details before proceeding.

It is your responsibility to verify the following:

  • Artwork, names, spelling, and layout
  • Size, quantity, colors, and placement
  • Product type, material, and application method
  • Shipping address and contact information

settings.heading: 3. Pricing, Payment & Currency
settings.body:
Unless stated otherwise, prices are shown in U.S. dollars. The final price may depend on product type, size, quantity, finishing options, and shipping selections.

Payment is generally required before production. Any separately negotiated wholesale or business payment terms must be confirmed in writing.

settings.heading: 4. Artwork Files & Revisions
settings.body:
Upload clear, correctly sized, print-ready artwork that you are authorized to use. Colors on screens may differ from printed results, and production methods have practical limitations.

If our team provides a proof, review it carefully. Revisions are subject to the product-specific terms and production status. We cannot guarantee changes once an order enters production.

settings.heading: 5. Production & Shipping
settings.body:
Production and delivery estimates displayed at checkout or on product pages are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates, unless expressly stated otherwise. Processing, carrier transit, weather, and high-volume periods can affect delivery.

Customers must provide complete and correct shipping details. Please refer to our published Shipping Policy for available shipping methods and applicable procedures.

settings.heading: 6. Cancellations, Refunds & Order Issues
settings.body:
Custom and made-to-order products may become non-cancellable once production begins. Returns, replacements, refunds, and claims are handled according to our published Refund Policy and applicable law.

If your order arrives damaged, defective, or materially different from what you ordered, contact our support team promptly with your order number and clear photographs so we can review the issue.

settings.heading: 7. Intellectual Property & Usage Rights
settings.body:
By uploading artwork or placing a custom order, you represent that you own the design or have permission to reproduce it. You remain responsible for securing any necessary trademarks, copyright licenses, or other rights.

We may decline orders that violate law, third-party rights, or our content standards. We will not publicly showcase customer artwork when a confidentiality agreement or other written restriction applies.

settings.heading: Pro Tip
settings.body: For the best results, double-check your artwork, dimensions, colors, and application instructions before placing an order.
